sar.narrative: Customer C10751, holder of card C10751-K1, is the subject of this report due to suspicious online purchasing activity occurring between 2016-11-24 17:00 and 2016-11-24 17:21. Specifically, 4 online transactions totaling $1,906.11 were executed via device profile 'Windows | Windows 10 | chrome 63.0 | ' in just 21 minutes, consisting of amounts of $464.46 (3483817 at 17:00), $488.58 (3483854 at 17:10), $477.85 (3483876 at 17:16), and $475.22 (3483895 at 17:21). Each transaction amount was kept just under a $500 authorization threshold to evade detection. This rapid band-burst pattern is suspicious because every amount sat just below $500, with the $477.85 transaction significantly exceeding the card's 95th percentile of $209.94 alongside an unprecedented product code C usage, despite the device profile having 13 prior transactions on the card. The activity is further suspicious because 8 of the 8 most similar closed cases, including CC-4124, CC-3841, CC-3907, and CC-4086, were confirmed fraud, matching an undocumented fraud pattern with an exposure of $1,906.11. Although the case-memory model score was 0.013 with a bank risk score of 0.14, the analyst requested a monitoring alert review for structuring. In response to these findings, the bank automatically created a case and escalated the matter to an analyst, while executing an L1 recommendation to block the card and an L2 recommendation to file this report.
